description: Deliberately induced failure cases for each error category the gateway must classify, captured as raw provider responses paired with the gateway's classification.

cases.how_to_trigger: Send requests faster than the provider's rate limit (e.g. a rapid-fire loop against Groq's free tier).
Send a prompt longer than the model's context window.
Send a malformed request, e.g. a missing required field or invalid role name.
Request a model name that does not exist / isn't pulled locally.
Any failure that doesn't match the other categories, e.g. an unexpected network hiccup.
